title: Malware created by Kimsuky, disguised as 2026 Engineering Company Wage Survey Results.pdf
content_md: Today I will write about the malware known as '2026 Engineering Company Wage Survey Results.pdf' created by the North Korean hacking group Kimsuky. This malware uses a PDF file from the Korean Industry Evaluation Research Institute to create a bait file. Article Link: https://malware.news/t/kimsuky-2026-pdf/125548#post_1
